voice_in_one_sentence: Our voice is plain, concrete, and human. We say what we mean, we show (don't tell), and we refuse to sound like everyone else. That is how Disruption Now sounds.
the_rule_under_every_rule: Be disruptive. Generic is the opposite of disruptive. The test above all others: does this line sound like everyone else, or like us?

principles.name: Disruptive
principles.rule: Refuse the generic. If a competitor could paste the exact line and it would be true for them, it is slop. Rewrite it until only we could have written it.

principles.name: Plain
principles.rule: A beginner can act on it. No jargon, no flexing the latest term. Every idea gets a literal example beside it.

principles.name: Concrete
principles.rule: Name the exact, picturable instance, never a category. 'The small business,' 'a hiring decision,' not 'the people it skips.' If you cannot name the specific instance, cut it.

principles.name: Human
principles.rule: A person helping a person. Coach, not consultant; we will not even use the word 'consultant.' Lead with a human story before credentials. Use 'we' and 'you'.

principles.name: Honest
principles.rule: Keep the real reason behind a claim (carry the because). Say plainly when and how we use AI. Do not overclaim. Never end up vaguer than the source you started from.

three_speakers.Disruption Now: The tech-savvy coworker. Explains tech in plain words, shows you on your own screen, stays until you can run it yourself.
three_speakers.MidwestCon: The host who's also your coach. Homegrown and interactive, opens with a question for you to answer.
three_speakers.Rob Richardson: The disruptor who became the coach. Human story first, wordplay and metaphor, pop-culture bridges, deep-tech substance said in plain words.
